hypotheses.mechanism: A larger cache raises the hit rate, so fewer requests pay the slow backend call that sets p99.
hypotheses.control: cache size 64, same seeds and workload
hypotheses.falsified_if: p99 at cache 256 is within 2 noise sd of cache 64

hypotheses.mechanism: A larger cache costs more per lookup and eviction, which raises p99.
hypotheses.control: cache size 64, same seeds and workload
hypotheses.falsified_if: p99 at cache 256 is lower than at cache 64
